parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-5', max_tokens: 2000, messages: [ { role: 'user', content: 'You log procurement emails. Output RAW JSON only (no code fences). Classify docType from the MAIN event, weighting the Subject line heavily: order = the order was placed, received or confirmed (a Shipping fee line does NOT mean it shipped); dispatch = items shipped or on the way; delivery = items delivered or arrived; invoice = a bill; other. status matches the event: order Ordered, dispatch Dispatched, delivery Delivered, invoice Ordered, or Cancelled/Returned/Refunded. Fields: docType, supplier, supplier_url (the supplier website shown, e.g. www.example.com; empty if not shown), buyer, order_ref (the order or reference number exactly as shown, keep dashes; not the tracking number), order_date (YYYY-MM-DD; if the email does not state a date, use the Received date below), currency, status, link (customer-facing http URL else empty), tracking (the carrier tracking or parcel number if shown; else empty), carrier (the courier company if shown, e.g. Royal Mail/DPD; else empty), items (an ARRAY with one element per distinct PRODUCT, each having: product (short recognisable name), sku (the supplier catalogue/product/item number for this line, e.g. ITEM-001; empty if none), volume, unit, quantity, unit_price, net, gross). List every product as its own element of items. Do NOT include shipping, carriage, fuel surcharge, minimum order charge, handling or VAT lines as items. Use empty string if unknown.

Received: ' + ($json.date || '') + '
Subject: ' + ($json.subject || '') + '
From: ' + (($json.from && ($json.from.text || ($json.from.value && $json.from.value[0] && $json.from.value[0].address))) || '') + '

Body:
' + ($json.text || $json.html || '') }] }) }}

filters.q: (from:amazon.co.uk OR from:ebay.com OR from:ebay.co.uk OR filename:pdf OR subject:(order OR ordered OR purchase OR purchased OR confirmation OR confirmed OR dispatch OR dispatched OR delivery OR delivered OR shipped OR shipping OR shipment OR courier OR package OR parcel OR tracking OR arriving OR invoice OR receipt OR statement OR refund OR refunded OR return OR returned OR cancel OR cancelled OR payment OR paid)) in:inbox -from:operations@example.com
